School Management Booked for Operating Bus Without Valid Documents

The management of Sri Rama Vidyakendra school has been booked for operating a school bus without valid documents. The case was registered in Karnataka following lapses in the bus's documentation. The specific nature of the document lapses has not been detailed in the coverage.
